'''Ancient Dreadnauts''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Ancient Parasites|Ancient]] Tier.

They are one of the Bosses of the mod.

== ''Spawning'' ==
Dreadnauts no longer spawn naturally until their upcoming rework.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Ancient Dreadnauts are Flying Ranged Summoner/Tank Hybrids. It must fly at least 7 blocks above the ground. Dreadnauts have a bossbar.

*Dreadnauts can shoot a series of 3 Projectiles, which inflict Wither, and spawn an effect cloud of Wither.
*Dreadnauts can swoop down towards their foes, inflicting great knockback.
*They can summon multiple [[Ancient Dreadnaut#Gallery|Ancient Pods]], which will fall from the sky towards the ground. Few seconds after landing, they will explode inflicting 50 damage, Saturation -20 for 10 seconds, and release a Lingering effect Cloud of Poison for 15 seconds. Dreadnaut must wait at least 12 seconds before it can summon Pods again, and a maximum of 5 can spawn. These Pods will spawn other Parasites ([[Ancient Dreadnaut#Summoning|More info below]])
*Every 20% HP taken, they will drop their [[Dreadnaut#Gallery|Ancient Tendrils]]. If they're not killed soon enough, they will start to spawn [[Buglin|Buglins]], the Tendrils will make grey particles before doing this. These Tendrils have 50 HP each.
*Dreadnauts can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 9, with a 5 ticks cooldown and 4 Blocks range.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Ancient Dreadnauts, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Dreadnauts have a chance to explode, releasing a large effect cloud of [[Viral]], [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]], and stacking Poison.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Dreadnauts are also known as '''Oronco''' in the Mod Files.
*Dreadnauts are inspired by the [https://strangerthings.fandom.com/wiki/The_Mind_Flayer Mind Flayer] from Stranger Things. 
*The [[Bogle]] and [[Wraith]]'s model are derived from the Dreadnaut, likely to have its visual concept implemented before the Dreadnaut is reworked and completely changed.
*The Ancient Dreadnaut's spawn egg denotes the Monumenta branch of [[Advancements]], which is related to slaying [[Nexus]] parasites.
**It shares the same egg texture with the [[Ancient Overlord]].
